short: Bolshevik forces seized power in Russia, leading to the creation of the world's first communist state.
full:
On 7 November 1917 (25 October in the Julian calendar), Bolshevik Red Guards and sympathetic soldiers occupied key points in Petrograd and stormed the Winter Palace, overthrowing the Russian Provisional Government. Orchestrated by Vladimir Lenin and Leon Trotsky, the nearly bloodless coup capitalized on massive popular discontent with the ongoing war and economic collapse.

The Bolsheviks immediately issued decrees proposing peace and the redistribution of land. The seizure of power plunged Russia into a devastating civil war and laid the foundation for the Soviet Union, fundamentally altering twentieth-century global politics and creating a deep ideological schism with the West.
